propositions: Current reconciliation mixes snapshot reads, binding lifecycle decisions, global mode caps, and handler assumptions without pure plan values, causing retry recovery to recompute against different observations

Planning must produce immutable per-ticket TicketPlan values containing mutations, lifecycle intents, dependencies, diagnostics, disposition, and version identity with zero I/O before any lifecycle or remote effect

Selection, filter, mode cap, and global safety limits must execute before lifecycle intents or remote operations become eligible, with blocked prerequisites explicitly deferred rather than emitted out of order
Shadow planner emits new immutable plans alongside legacy dispatch with zero write authority, comparing mutations and dispositions to detect unexplained behavioral divergence
Preview must preserve existing mutation array, canonical hash, and serialization while adding versioned lifecycle-intents section that legacy consumers can ignore
